name: A Transforming Night to Remember!
source:
Percy finds himself heading to a small house in the forest with his boyfriend and their two other friends to conduct a short investigation. There he will learn about the "Automated Peacock", a creature known to transform anything it comes into contact with. While his boyfriend, Wyatt, is estatic and eager to search for clues for this not-so-known creature, Percy is not as engaged. After all, a creature who is known to transform people couldn't possibly exist, right? 

In any case, it'll certainly be a night to remember.

[From [url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/a-transforming-night-to-remember]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
珀西发现自己正与男友和另外两个朋友前往森林中的一座小房子进行简短的调查。在那里，他将了解“自动孔雀”，这是一种可以改变它接触到的任何东西的生物。虽然他的男朋友怀亚特兴高采烈，渴望寻找这个不为人知的生物的线索，但珀西却没有那么投入。毕竟，已知能够改变人类的生物是不可能存在的，对吧？

无论如何，这肯定会是一个值得纪念的夜晚。

[来自[url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/a-transforming-night-to-remember]Itch.io[/url]]
